reason: I've already built my own client system in Notion and I like tinkering with it, so paying $12 a month to move into someone else's version doesn't make sense. Email runs my whole day, and I'm not handing that to an all-in-one app that's probably weaker than the client I already use.
objection: All-in-one apps end up mediocre at everything, and email is the one thing I can't afford to be mediocre. I'd probably keep my real email client open next to it anyway, and then it's just one more app.
would_change_my_mind: If I could keep my own email client and just have Moduo pull in each client's emails, tasks and meetings automatically, with an easy import from my Notion setup, I might try the free plan.
